app.title: Trader Discipline OS

app.safetyCopy: Nazm helps review plans, journals, risk, context, and lessons. It is not a broker or financial advisor.

session.label: Session window

onboarding.title: Get started
onboarding.subtitle: Answer four quick questions and we'll set a discipline-first starting plan.
onboarding.intro: A few short steps to get your journal going. Skip any time and come back later.
onboarding.buildFailed: We could not build the plan. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.saveFailed: We could not save the sprint. Try again.

flow.loadFailed: We could not load your saved setup, so this starts from the first step.

platform.title: How do you trade?
platform.hint: Pick the closest one. You can change it later.

mt5.title: MetaTrader 5 (MT5)
mt5.description: I trade on MT5 and can export my history report.

other.title: Another platform
other.description: I can export my trades from my platform as a CSV file.

manual.title: A manual journal
manual.description: I will enter my trades myself.

goal.title: What is your goal?
goal.hint: Pick what matters most to you right now. Nothing is locked in.

risk.title: Risk management
risk.description: Keep the risk of each trade and each day in check.

performance.title: Performance review
performance.description: See how my trades have really gone.

strategy.title: Strategy improvement
strategy.description: Learn from how each of my strategies has done.

mt5.title: Import your history
mt5.body: Upload your MT5 history report. You see a preview before anything is saved, and uploading the same report again adds no duplicates.

other.title: Import your trades from a file
other.body: Export your trades from your platform as a CSV file, then upload it on the import page. You see a preview before anything is saved.

manual.title: Add your first trade
manual.body: Open the journal and record a trade you already took, or write each trade down as you go.

history.done: You already have trades in your journal. This step is done.

strategy.title: Create your first strategy
strategy.body: A strategy is your written rules for one way of trading: when you enter, when you leave and how much you risk. Trades and plans can then be linked to it.
strategy.done: You already have a strategy. This step is done.

finish.title: See it filled in
finish.body: See what the screens look like once they hold trades, strategies and plans, or go straight to your own empty dashboard.
finish.bodyOwn: Your journal already holds your own trades. Open your dashboard to see them.
finish.bodySample: Sample data is already loaded. Open your dashboard to look around; remove it any time with the "Remove sample data" button at the top of the page.
finish.sampleNote: Sample data is made up and is not your own. Remove it any time with the "Remove sample data" button at the top of the page; it is also removed automatically as soon as you add your first real trade.
finish.sampleFailed: We could not load the sample data. You can try again or go to your dashboard.
finish.sampleNotEmpty: Your journal already has trades of its own, so sample data was not loaded. Sample data is only for an empty journal.
